name: Everything Under Control
description: Viktor wants a look at Pavel’s report before it is collected. Read it, show Viktor, and return it without drawing attention.
offerText: Check Pavel Sokolov's letter in Center's postbox at night.

stages.description: Take Pavel Sokolov's letter from Center's postbox at night.
Show the letter to Viktor. Viktor notices the same military routing seal used on other deliveries.
Put the letter back into Center's postbox at night.

_codex.narrativeIntent: Viktor asks the player to temporarily intercept Pavel’s report and return it, learning that supply transfers are deliberately concealed.
implementationNotes: Keep center-post, night restriction and return-to-postbox mechanic.
The report contains a transport seal/code; do not make it a full confession.
_codex.compatibility: _codex is design metadata, not an executable trigger. Keep all original IDs, trigger shapes, rewards, and existing save compatibility. Add runtime support only after implementing the documented systems.
